evidence: Official Purdue campus-map ArcGIS feature 85 is code HARR, named Benjamin Harrison Residence Hall.
The saved GIS ring has 28 distinct vertices; the Blender asset's HARR_Ground_Plinth_Base has 28 base vertices.

findings: The GIS record is an official campus-map polygon, not a certified survey; it verifies horizontal shape and identity rather than facade or vertical geometry.

criteria.criterion: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
evidence: Purdue OEP states the north and south wings are 8 stories and the central section is 2 stories; the model renders corresponding tall paired wings and a low central connector.
Reopened major north/south brick cores span z=3.80..26.60 m locally; total asset geometry reaches z=30.35 m.
The model depicts roof decks/parapets and mechanical penthouses.
findings: No authoritative total building height, roof elevation, roof construction, or floor-to-floor dimensions were located; total height and current roof form remain unverified.
The GIS record carries a 10-level attribute, but its accompanying source review marks vertical GIS fields unverified; the direct OEP story description is preferred.

evidence: Reopened renders show red-brown brick wing masses, repeated vertical window bays, a central entrance canopy/storefront, courtyard glazing, and a west solar-screen grid.
The Purdue emergency plan and Residences page substantiate the three-part wing arrangement and central common-area connector.
An official Purdue Residences page identifies a photo taken outside the Harrison Hall entrance, but provides no measured exterior facade information.
findings: The exact brick/window composition, solar-screen dimensions, and canopy/entrance design are not corroborated by elevation drawings or a sufficiently detailed exterior source in the asset's evidence record.

criteria.criterion: Modular export, portability, and evidence completeness
evidence: The actual asset reopened in Blender 4.5.15 LTS with the manifest scene, collection, 224 objects, and exact manifest object name/count agreement.
Collection-only export reopened with 224 objects; there are no external images or linked libraries.
The manifest preserves local geometry and a campus placement origin.
findings: The exported building collection contains 3 cameras and 1 light alongside the geometry.

No canonical `modular/buildings/build_benjamin_harrison_hall.py` or building-specific source/evidence folder exists; manifest source_metadata is empty, so the model cannot be reproduced from a documented source-backed build workflow.

The asset was saved in Blender 5.0.2 and reopened by Blender 4.5.15; its legacy `BLENDER_EEVEE` engine identifier is unavailable in the older runtime. Geometry and collection export reopened, and preview renders succeeded after switching render engine in memory.
The model has an excellent source-backed horizontal shell and matches the GIS ring to submillimeter accuracy.
The official Purdue emergency plan supports the three-wing layout and 8-story/2-story massing, but does not verify total height or roof geometry.
The main completion gap is evidence and reproducibility: no dedicated builder/source record exists and render cameras/lights are part of the exported asset collection.
Overall independent grade is below the repository's 8/10 finish threshold.
